The '''''Justifier''''' was a [[starship]] owned by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]]. It had a central thruster that was capable of reorienting itself laterally, so that it would align itself horizontally with the ship.<ref name="Untold CW" /> When he acquired [[Omega]] as a bounty for [[Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su]], Cad Bane went to [[Bora Vio]] to rendezvous with the [[Kaminoan]]s to hand the girl over. However, Bane was accosted by the bounty hunter [[Fennec Shand]], who had been hired to [[Rescue of Omega|prevent]] the Kaminoan government from acquiring Omega. After a [[Unarmed combat|fight]] with Shand, Bane found his ship sabotaged, leaving him unable to pursue Shand or the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]].<ref name="Bounty Lost" /> Following this, Bane would continue to use the ship on several missions tracking [[Midi-chlorian|M-count]] targets for the Empire, which he would deliver to [[Imperial Station 003]] above [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Identity Crisis">{{TBB|Identity Crisis}}</ref>

==Description==
The Justifier was a medium sized [[transport]] with two wings and a rear adjustable thruster pillar. It was armed with two laser cannons on the tip of each wing. The ship's cockpit had a large opaque [[viewport]] which provided unobstructed view of the surrounding space, and two large forward-facing lights on top of it.

On the rear of the ship was its most easily identifiable component, the large adjustable thruster pillar. When in a landing configuration, the pillar was locked in a horizontal position parallel to the ship and the ground. When in a takeoff and travel configuration though, the pillar was capable of rotating 90 degrees and being locked in a position vertical to the ship's body, exposing the [[engine]] thrusters and allowing use of the hyperdrive.<ref name="Bounty Lost">{{TBB|Bounty Lost}}</ref><ref name="ReunionSW">{{SW|url=reunion-concept-art-gallery|text="Reunion" Concept Art Gallery}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Oh yeah, that was his ship, the ''Justifier'', designed by Russell Chong. So it had a reorienting center piece thruster, that kinda—you can see that big, tall pillar—it folded back flat into the ship and then folded up.|Dave Filoni|<ref name="Untold CW">{{SWYouTube|7yKM6RExLlI|The Untold Clone Wars Panel | Star Wars Celebration Anaheim}}</ref>}}
[[File:Justifier_TCWconcept.png|thumb|250px|Concept art of the ''Justifier'']]
The ''Justifier'' was created for an [[The Clone Wars Legacy#Bounty Hunter Arc|unfinished four-episode arc]] starring Cad Bane and [[Boba Fett]] in the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', prior to the series' cancellation. [[Dave Filoni]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]] revealed concept art for the ''Justifier'' during "The Untold ''Clone Wars''" Panel at [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]] in [[April]] [[2015]]. The ship was designed by [[Russell G. Chong]] and would have appeared in an episode with production code 5.23, which was the second episode of the arc.<ref name="Untold CW" /> The ship finally debuted in the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' episode "[[Bounty Lost]]."<ref name="Bounty Lost" /> The online episode guide for ''The Bad Batch'' episode "[[Reunion]]" showed concept art of the ''Justifier'', revealing that its exterior design had changed somewhat from the original ''Clone Wars'' concept.<ref name="Reunion EG">{{SW|url=reunion-concept-art-gallery|text="Reunion" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slides 1-4}}</ref>
